visio_print.type_rule: printed size = the lattice point of the authored size (a half-way size may go either way) plus 0 to 0.05 pt (T2, T3)
visio_print.line_rule: printed stroke = one device pixel (lattice x 1.001) for a weight up to one lattice step, else the weight as written (T4, measured)

arrow_head.rule: printed head width = EndArrowSize base (0.04/0.05/0.07/0.09 in) + 2 x the line's authored width; closed head as long, open head half (T4, measured)

visio_print.measurement: motor/visio/olcum/basim_olcumu_96dpi.json and ok_ucu_olcumu_96dpi.json (agent MV, 30.10.2026, Visio 16.0, 96 DPI)

a1.rule: the page is the venue width of its kind on Visio's print lattice; the scale may read 0.999 or 1.001 to three decimals (snap_page, T3)
